user.title: Add NFC Tasgs device
user.description: Set up a device to track through NFC tag scans.

actions.title: Actions
actions.description: Add the actions that can be logged for this device. At least one action is required.

add_action.title: Add action

data.label: Label
data.triggers_purchase: Adds an item to the shopping list
data.triggers_task: Creates a task in the task list

add_action.description: The internal key is generated from the label automatically (for example, “Beans Refilled” becomes “beans_refilled”). How often is used for the first reminder; after two logs, NFC Tasgs follows your actual rhythm.

edit_action_form.title: Edit action

data.label: Label
data.triggers_purchase: Adds an item to the shopping list
data.triggers_task: Creates a task in the task list

edit_action_form.description: The internal key stays fixed when you rename the label, so history and entities are preserved. How often is used for the first reminder; after two logs, NFC Tasgs follows your actual rhythm.

finish.title: Default action
finish.description: Choose the action logged on a single scan.

template.title: Choose an appliance
template.description: Start with a preset. You can keep or omit any action.

template_actions.title: Choose actions
template_actions.description: Tick the actions you want to track. The time shown is used for the first reminder; after two logs, NFC Tasgs follows your actual rhythm.

error.invalid_key: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only.
